detail.longDescription:
One of the most popular Nix template collections, the ones from the-nix-way, is provided under the MPL 2.0 license. As I understand (IANAL) that means you have to:

1. Include a copy of the license
2. Credit the source
3. Continue to license your modified version under MPL 2.0
4. Provide the original unmodified version (!)

Clearly nobody is doing this (except me), right? The point of the template is that you edit it to your own application. Why did they choose that license?

#nix #opensource
